title: Cold Caller / Acquisitions VA — Real Estate Wholesaling (Oklahoma)
description:
We're hiring ONE dedicated cold caller to drive our outbound acquisitions. You'll be calling motivated property sellers in Oklahoma, following our proven scripts and systems, and setting qualified appointments for our acquisitions team.



This is not a "dial and pray" gig. We have a complete, professional system already built — an 88-page Team Operations Manual, phone scripts, SMS/email templates, drip campaigns, and training tests. You'll study and master these materials before you ever touch a live lead.



HARD REQUIREMENTS (Do not apply without these):



• Hands-on REsimpli experience — You must already know how to navigate REsimpli: update lead statuses, log call dispositions, add notes, manage drip campaigns, and use the built-in dialer. We will NOT train you on REsimpli basics.



• Real estate cold calling experience — At least 6 months of cold calling property sellers (not buyers, not generic telemarketing). You understand seller objections, motivation levels, and how to qualify leads.



• Clear, neutral English — You'll be speaking with property owners across Oklahoma. Your English must be conversational, confident, and easy to understand.



• Reliable internet + quiet workspace — No background noise, no shared call centers. Professional environment only.



• Willingness to study and be tested — Before you make a single call, you will complete our full training program and pass both an open-book and closed-book exam (80% minimum to pass). This is non-negotiable.



Our Training & Onboarding Process:



We don't throw you on the phones and hope for the best. Here's how onboarding works:



Week 1 — Study Phase:

• You'll receive our 88-page Team Operations Manual — covers our entire acquisition system, seller psychology, NEPQ conversation framework, offer formulas, Oklahoma compliance rules, operator cards, battle drills, and default decisions

• You'll also receive our REsimpli Complete Toolkit — 10 phone scripts, 18 SMS templates, 7
 templates, 9 drip campaigns, and 4 task sequences already built and ready to use

• Study both documents thoroughly



Week 1 (End) — Testing:

• Open Book Test — 33 scenario-based questions (you can reference the manual). 80% to pass.

• Closed Book Test — 48 questions fro
mory. 80% to pass.

• If you don't pass, you get one retake. If you don't pass the retake, the trial is over.



Week 2 — Supervised Calling:

• Once you pass both tests, you get REsimpli access and begin live calls

• All calls recorded for QA

• Daily check-ins during Week 2



Week 3+ — Full Production:

• 150–200+ outbound dials per day

• Independent operation within our systems

• Weekly KPI review



What Success Looks Like:



• 150–200+ outbound dials per day

• 2–5+ qualified leads per week

• Accurate REsimpli updates on every call (status, notes, disposition, follow-up tasks)

• All drip campaigns and follow-up sequences triggered correctly

• Professional, empathetic tone with every seller — no high-pressure tactics

• Appointments set for acquisitions team on qualified leads

Nice-to-Haves (not required):



• Experience with Mojo Dialer, BatchDialer, or similar power dialers

• Familiarity with skip tracing tools (BatchLeads, PropStream)

• NEPQ or consultative selling training

• Experience in Oklahoma or Southern US markets

• Previous wholesaling VA role (not just cold calling for agents/investors)

To Apply:



Send a short message that includes:

1. How many months/years of RE cold calling experience you have

2. Which CRMs you've used (specifically confirm REsimpli experience)

3. A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself (so I can hear your English and phone presence)

4. Your expected hourly rate in USD

5. Your available hours in US Central Time



No generic applications. If your message doesn't include all 5 items, it will be skipped.

title: Recruiting Assistant and Candidate Sourcer (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
Job Description:



We're a recruiting agency based in the US that places creative strategists and marketing professionals at e-commerce and DTC brands. We're growing fast and need a sharp, detail-oriented person to help us find and vet candidates through online conversations and data scraping tools.



This is not a traditional VA role. You'll be actively sourcing candidates using tools like Apollo, Phantom Buster, Hunter, Snov, Clay, and similar platforms to build targeted prospect lists. Then you'll be having real conversations with those candidates on LinkedIn and other platforms, learning about their background, evaluating their experience, and determining whether they'd be a good fit for our clients.



If you're someone who knows how to use scraping and enrichment tools to find the right people at scale, can hold a professional conversation in English, and enjoys the intersection of research and human interaction, this role will be a great fit.



What You'll Do



Use data scraping and enrichment tools (Apollo, Phantom Buster, Hunter, Snov, Clay, or similar) to build targeted candidate prospect lists at scale. Find creative strategists and marketing professionals through LinkedIn, job boards, online communities, and scraped data. Send outreach messages to potential candidates using scripts and templates we provide. Have back-and-forth DM conversations with interested candidates to learn about their experience, skills, and what they're looking for. These conversations follow a guide we provide but should feel natural, not scripted. Collect key information from each conversation including background, experience level, portfolio, salary expectations, availability, and how they think about their work. Organize and update all candidate information in our CRM (Airtable). Flag strong candidates for the founder to review. Send polite decline messages to candidates who aren't a fit. Follow up with candidates who haven't responded. Monitor our LinkedIn job listing for new applicants and reach out to promising ones. Research candidates before conversations by checking their LinkedIn profile and any available portfolio or work samples. Keep detailed notes on every interaction.



Who You Are



Strong written English. This is the most important requirement. You'll be having professional conversations with people in the US, UK, and other English-speaking countries. Your messages need to read naturally, with proper grammar, spelling, and a conversational tone.



Experienced with scraping and prospecting tools. You've used Apollo, Phantom Buster, Hunter, Snov, Clay, or similar tools to build prospect lists and find contact information. You know how to set up searches, run scrapes, enrich data, and organize the output into clean usable lists. If you've built lead generation systems before, even better.



Good with people. Even through text, you can build rapport quickly. You're naturally curious and good at getting people to open up about their experience.



Organized and detail-oriented. You'll be managing conversations with dozens of candidates at different stages simultaneously. Nothing falls through the cracks.



Self-motivated. You'll be given daily targets and a clear process. You manage your own time and hit your targets consistently.



Good judgment. Not every candidate who responds is a good fit. You can read a conversation and sense whether someone is strong, average, or not worth pursuing.



Comfortable with technology. You'll be using LinkedIn, Airtable, Google Workspace, scraping tools, and potentially other platforms. You should be comfortable learning new tools quickly.



Required Experience



Strong written English communication skills. Non-negotiable.

Hands-on experience with at least one data scraping or prospecting tool (Apollo, Phantom Buster, Hunter, Snov, Clay, or similar).

Experience building prospect lists or lead lists in a professional setting.

Experience using LinkedIn in a professional capacity.

Experience with any CRM, database, or spreadsheet tool (Airtable, Google Sheets, HubSpot, or similar).

Experience in any role that involved outreach, research, recruiting, lead generation, or candidate communication.



Preferred Experience (Not Required)



Previous experience in recruiting, sourcing, or talent acquisition.

Familiarity with the marketing, advertising, or e-commerce industry.

Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

Experience setting up automated scraping workflows or multi-tool prospecting systems.



**Schedule**



Full-time. Must be available during US business hours for at least 5 to 6 hours of overlap with Eastern Standard Time.



How to Apply



Send a short message introducing yourself. Tell me about any experience you have with outreach, research, recruiting, or candidate communication. Mention which scraping and prospecting tools you've used and how you've used them. Include your LinkedIn profile if you have one. Write your application in your own words. Do not use AI to write it. I want to see how you communicate naturally because that's the core of this role.



We'll send a short test to qualified applicants before making a final decision.

title: Senior-Level Graphic Designer
description:
We Are Hiring: Senior-Level Graphic Designer



We are on the lookout for a highly skilled and experienced senior-level graphic designer to join our team on a long-term, ongoing, month-to-month basis. This is a role for a seasoned professional who can bring technical expertise, creative problem-solving, and a meticulous eye for detail to every project.



What We’re Looking For

We need a designer who:

- Has strong technical design skills and a keen eye for detail.

- Can self-manage projects and timelines to ensure on-time delivery without constant oversight.

- Excels at following directions and adhering to project guidelines.



Required Skills

To excel in this role, you must have:

- Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop).

- Prepress knowledge and experience, including converting colors for print and file packaging.

- The ability to correct minor errors, such as inconsistent capitalization in client-delivered content.

- Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to follow directions precisely.

- A creative approach to problem-solving.

- Strong typography skills (e.g., fixing rags and kerning appropriately).

- Real-world client experience.

- The ability to recognize your limits and know when to push them.



Bonus Skills

If you have any of the following, you’ll stand out even more:

- WordPress expertise (especially with DIVI).

- Content writing capabilities.

- Illustration skills.



Typical Projects

Here’s a glimpse of the types of projects you’ll work on:

- Creating website mockups in Photoshop.

- Laying out print brochures.

- Updating or designing print ads.

- Developing brand designs.

- Crafting multipage brochures for companies.



How We Work

- We use Trello to manage projects.

- Projects are typically assigned during the first half of the week.

- Questions about a project should be asked within a day or two of assignment.

- Working files must always be stored on our cloud drive.

- Project time is tracked using our time-tracking software.

- You’ll be provided with brand assets, working files, and access to stock images and graphics as needed.



Compensation

- This position pays $15 USD per hour.



---



How to Apply

To be considered, you must follow these instructions carefully. Applications that do not meet these requirements will not be reviewed.



Please provide:

1. A portfolio with at least 10 work samples. (If you only send 10 samples, prioritize longer-form design content such as reports, full ad campaigns, and white papers. Limit logos/brand designs to no more than two, and no more than two should be social media-related.)

2. Your Resume/CV.

3. A written explanation of what uniquely qualifies you for this position.

4. A response to the following: Are there any skills listed under “Required Skills” that you do not have? If so, explain why you feel you should still be considered.

5. A response to the following: Do you have any of the “Bonus Skills”? If yes, explain. If you have additional skills, let us know!

6. Confirmation of whether you consider yourself detail-oriented and able to follow directions precisely.

7. Your availability for a video interview in the next week (include days and times in EST).

8. Your availability to work (hours per week).

---



About the Role



We are a growing SaaS company looking for a detail?oriented SOP Writer to help us document core business processes.  all requirements to

title: Manufacturing Operations & ERP Coordinator
description:
We are a rapidly growing USA-based manufacturing company operating in supplements, peptides, and chemical/research products. We are currently building scalable systems for inventory management, manufacturing operations, batch traceability, ERP workflows, and documentation control.



We are looking for a highly organized, process-driven Operations & ERP Coordinator to help manage and improve our operational systems.



This is NOT a general virtual assistant role.



We are seeking someone who enjoys structure, organization, inventory systems, documentation, ERP workflows, and operational problem-solving.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



ERP & Inventory Management



1) Help build, organize, and maintain our Katana ERP system

2) Manage raw material, packaging, and finished goods inventory records

3) Track inventory movement, lot numbers, and production consumption

4) Reconcile inventory discrepancies and identify operational issues

5) Help organize warehouse inventory structure and location tracking

6) Help structure and maintain product BOMs (Bill of Materials)

7) Assist with raw material consumption tracking and production costing

8) Help maintain accurate product cost and inventory usage data inside the ERP system

9) Support purchasing, receiving, and inventory control workflows

10) Help improve operational workflows and inventory discipline



Documentation & Quality Systems



* Organize and maintain structured Google Drive documentation systems

* Maintain COA logs, batch logs, supplier records, SDS archives, and inventory logs

* Maintain document naming conventions and revision control

* Organize production records and manufacturing documentation



Operational Systems Development



* Help create scalable workflows for:

* Receiving inventory

* Production staging

* Batch tracking

* Inventory reconciliation

* Finished goods tracking

* Identify operational gaps and recommend process improvements



REQUIRED SKILLS



* Strong Google Sheets / Excel skills

* Excellent organizational ability

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent written English

* Comfortable working with inventory systems and structured workflows

* Able to think structurally and improve systems independently



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



* ERP systems (Katana, Odoo, NetSuite, SAP, MRPeasy, Fishbowl, etc.)

* Manufacturing operations support

* Inventory management

* GMP or ISO documentation systems

* QA documentation

* Nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, or manufacturing industry experience



PERSONALITY FIT



We are looking for someone who is:



* Extremely organized and detail-oriented

* Process-driven and structured in their thinking

* Reliable, consistent, and able to follow through

* Calm under pressure and able to handle operational complexity

* Comfortable building and maintaining organized systems

* Able to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities

* Proactive in identifying problems and recommending improvements

* Comfortable asking operational questions and helping improve workflows

* Interested in long-term operational stability and process improvement

* Comfortable taking leadership within operational systems and helping guide structure as the company scales



LEADERSHIP & OWNERSHIP



This role requires someone who is not simply waiting for instructions, but someone who can think operationally and help guide system organization and process improvement.



The ideal candidate is comfortable:



* identifying operational gaps

* recommending process improvements

* helping structure workflows

* improving organization and system accuracy

* helping build scalable operational systems

* communicating clearly when additional information or process changes are needed



We value people who take pride in building organized, efficient, and scalable systems and who are comfortable taking ownership of operational responsibilities over time.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys organization, systems, inventory management, operational workflows, and creating structure within growing companies.





IMPORTANT

This role will initially focus heavily on operational organization, inventory control, ERP structure, and documentation systems as we transition into a more structured manufacturing environment.



Long-term, this role is intended to become a key operational support position within the company.



TO APPLY

Please include:



1. Your experience with ERP or inventory systems

2. Your experience with manufacturing, QA, or documentation systems

3. Your experience organizing Google Drive or structured document systems

4. Examples of operational systems or workflows you have managed

5. Your expected monthly compensation

6. Your internet speed and computer specifications

title: # Amazon UK & EU Operations Manager (VA) — Orellana UK
description:
Amazon UK & EU Operations Manager (VA) — Orellana UK



We're a fast-growing Amazon agency managing brand growth across European marketplaces. As we scale, we need someone to own the operational backbone of our business — an organised, proactive operator who can keep everything running smoothly across multiple brands on multiple marketplaces without needing to be chased.



This is a full-time remote position. You won't just be following instructions — you'll be building and improving the systems that keep the business moving.



---



Who We Are



At Orellana, our core belief is simple: every brand and product is our own.



We grow when our brands grow. That means we hold ourselves to a high standard across everything we do, and we need the same from every person on the team. You'll know each product deeply, not just the accounts. We're transparent, accountable, and always looking for a better way to do things.



If you're someone who gets things done without being asked twice, who builds systems instead of workarounds, and who naturally reaches for AI to work smarter — you'll fit right in.



---



What You'll Own



Amazon Account Operations



- Day-to-day management of Amazon Seller Central across multiple EU marketplaces (UK, DE, FR, IT, ES and more)

- Monitor account health, listings, performance notifications, and inbox — flagging and resolving issues proactively

- Manage and respond to Seller Central cases through to resolution

- Monitor listings daily — identify suppressed listings, catalogue errors, unauthorised sellers, and act on them immediately

- Co ordinate with PPC team and other departments of the business



Finance & Bookkeeping



- Collect and organise invoices from suppliers and service providers

- Submit sourcing costs and COGS accurately into **Sellerboard**

- Manage and reconcile accounts within Sellerboard and other softwares  — ensuring P&L data is clean and up to date

- General bookkeeping support and flagging discrepancies



Inventory & Replenishment



- Track inbound shipments — recording items ordered and shipped, reconciling against what arrives

- Identify and raise damaged or missing deliveries with  Amazon  the supplier or warehouse team

- Monitor stock levels across EU marketplaces and proactively suggest replenishments.



Software Management



- Manage and maintain **Sellerboard**, **Scale Insights,** **Repricer  and all Software** on an ongoing basis

- Ensure data is accurate, settings are optimised, and anything that looks off is flagged



Supplier Communication



- Maintain clear and professional communication with suppliers and warehouse partners

- Chase purchase orders, flag discrepancies, and coordinate on damaged or missing goods



Listing Management & Catalogue



- Conduct keyword research and build new listings to a high standard alongside the PPC Team

- Ensure all listings — front end and back end — are optimised , monitored and up to date on a weekly basis, providing performance reports.

- Audit the catalogue regularly for gaps, errors, or outdated content and action them without being asked



Systems & SOPs



- Work within existing Orellana SOPs and actively contribute to improving and completing them

- Document new processes clearly as you build them

- Identify inefficiencies and propose better ways of doing things



---



What We're Looking For



- Proven experience managing Amazon Seller Central across EU marketplaces — you know the platform inside and out

- AI-first mindset — you actively use AI tools  in your day-to-day work, not as a novelty but as a genuine productivity multiplier. You build prompts, create workflows, and find ways to do more with less

- Experience with Sellerboard, Scale Insights, Google Workspace, Slack and more

- Highly organised with strong attention to detail — you notice the things others miss

- Proactive and self-directed — you don't wait to be told something is wrong,

- Excellent written and spoken English for supplier and internal communication

- Reliable internet connection and professional remote setup

- Able to overlap with UK working hours (minimum 4 hours per day)



You should be able to work across multiple EU languages, this is not a native speaking role but core understadning of Amazon PAN EU operation.



Bonus skills:



- Experience managing TikTok Shop / TikTok Seller Central

- Experience managing eBay

- Experience in WMS systems and other Amazon Aggregator Agencies



---



 How to Apply



A few things to keep our process efficient:



- Start your message with  RIVER to confirm you've read this post in full.

- If you used AI tools  to help write your application, include "AI" at the end of your message — no judgement, just transparency.

- We're looking for an individual. Applications from agencies will not be considered.



Tell us about a process or system you built or improved in a previous role — what was the problem, what did you do, and what changed? We read every application.



Bonus: Share a specific example of how you use AI tools in your Seller Central Operations work.



We'll be in touch with next steps.

title: UGC Video Editor
description:

My name is Ibrahim, and I am the founder of Miras, a sportswear start-up.



We strive to create the best football shirts on planet earth. We have done so with our first launch, by creating a Turkish football shirt that received an unbelievable response.

Our next strategy is working with as many micro-influencers as possible and send them a shirt in exchange for an authentic video about our shirt. We will then run these videos across all of our social media channels as paid ads. Together, we will build an army of creators.

Results

- A cohesive, premium social presence that reinforces and amplifies the creator's broader ecosystem.

title: Google Ads + SEO + AI Web Specialist — AU Agency, Trades Niche
description:
ABOUT BUILD UP FLOW



Build Up Flow (BUF) is an Australian growth agency working with trades, construction, and design businesses. Right now we're focused on the AU market — as we grow, we're expanding into the US and other English-speaking markets.



We're not a one-service vendor — we're an integrated growth partner running paid ads, recruitment, and systems for clients who care about pipeline, not impressions.



We move fast. We're direct. If you like fluff or hide behind reports, this isn't your seat.



THE ROLE



You'll own everything Google for BUF clients: Google Ads, SEO, and the websites the SEO actually lives on. Most of our clients need a proper foundation built — site + keywords + technical SEO + Search/PMax campaigns — then ongoing optimisation.



We don't want a traditional web developer. We want someone who uses AI to build sites fast and well — Lovable, v0, Bolt, Claude, GHL's AI builder, WordPress + AI plugins, whatever tool fits the job. If AI can build it in a day, that's the move. Your value is in knowing what to build, wiring SEO into the structure, and making it look and convert like a professional did it — not in writing custom code.



You'll use AI heavily across everything: keyword research, content briefs, on-page optimisation, schema, site builds, ad copy. We don't care which tools you use — we care that the output is sharp and the work moves fast.



This is a part-time role starting at around 10 hours/week across our current client load. We add new clients regularly, and your hours, pay, and account load grow with us. We want someone who treats BUF like their own agency, not a side gig.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Build and manage Google Ads campaigns — Search, Performance Max, Display, retargeting

- Full-stack SEO: keyword research, on-page, technical, content briefs, internal linking, schema

- Use AI to build and iterate on client websites fast (Lovable, v0, GHL AI builder, WordPress + AI, or whatever fits) — SEO baked in from the structure up, not bolted on

- Use AI daily across keyword research, content generation, site copy, and on-page optimisation

- Map keyword clusters to site architecture and content plans

- Set up tracking properly — GA4, GTM, conversion tracking, call tracking

- Document your process and updates in Notion (our whole knowledge base lives there)

- Weekly reporting on Google Ads performance and SEO movement with a clear point of view

- Communicate directly with the BUF team via Slack / Loom / call



MUST-HAVES



- 3+ years managing Google Ads (Search + PMax minimum)

- Strong SEO knowledge — technical, on-page, and content

- Proven track record managing AU, US, or UK client accounts

- Proven ability to build professional websites using AI tools — show us sites you've shipped using Lovable, v0, Bolt, GHL, WordPress + AI, or similar

- Strong taste — you can spot AI-slop and produce output that looks like a designer built it

- GoHighLevel — comfortable building sites and funnels inside it

- Notion — comfortable working inside it daily for SOPs, tracking, and documentation

- AI tools — Claude (web + Projects), Claude Code, ChatGPT used daily for real work, not novelty

- Strong English written communication

- Reliable internet + ability to overlap with Australian business hours (AEST)

- You can read a dashboard and form an opinion, not just describe what you see



BONUS



- Experience with trades, home services, solar, or construction clients

- Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimisation experience

- Familiar with n8n or other automation tools

- Familiar with multiple AI site builders and knows when to use which

- Has built or contributed to a GHL website template/snapshot

- Good English speaking skills



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "GROW" so we know you read this.



Send:

1. A short paragraph on a Google Ads result you're proud of (numbers — spend, CPL, conversion rate)

2. A site you've built using AI tools — link it, tell us which tools you used

3. One ranking improvement you've driven (keyword, position movement, timeframe)

4. The AI tools you use weekly and one specific way you use them in SEO or web builds

5. Your rate and weekly availability



Applications without the keyword get deleted.

title: LET Senior Content Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



Meedu is a UK ed-tech platform helping students revise for high-stakes exams. We are building the LET (Licensure Examination for Teachers) review platform for Filipino teachers, with a free MCQ bank launching for the September 2026 cycle.



We are hiring one senior, highly qualified licensed teacher to help us bring our LET course to a publishable standard, author new high-quality MCQs, and become the credibility face for the platform.



This is a premium freelance review and content authoring engagement to begin with. A senior public-facing role (with your name on the course) may follow as a separate engagement once the course is polished, for the right fit. We want the best, not the most. If you do not meet the hard requirements below, please do not apply.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Review 1000+ AI-generated LET MCQs for factual accuracy, exam-style fidelity, and clarity. Flag errors, fix explanations, and bring the quality bar up to publishable standard.



Author 200+ new high-quality MCQs in your specialist subject area to fill gaps in the curriculum coverage.



Provide structural feedback on the existing course (LET Elementary mock course is already built and seeded with content).



Cross-reference content against other established LET review resources (review centre materials, textbooks, official exam guides, mock papers) to validate accuracy and flag gaps in our coverage. You may also be asked to occasionally cross-reference resources from our other exam-prep verticals.



Co-create with our team on what good content looks like for the LET audience: stem structure, distractor design, explanation depth, common student traps.



Optional: be the on-platform face once the course is polished. Not required for this initial engagement. We may bring in a separate senior educator for the public-facing role once the course is ready, and strong reviewers may be considered for that role too.



Optionally: contribute short-form social content (your face or voice in clips) to support the launch. Additional payment if you opt in.



HARD REQUIREMENTS



If you do not meet ALL of the following, your application will not be reviewed.



Bachelor's degree in Education (BEEd, BSEd, or related field).



Valid LPT (Licensed Professional Teacher) from the Professional Regulation Commission. Your licence number and registration year must be included in your application.



Minimum 5 years classroom teaching experience.



You personally passed the LET. Include the year you took it and your result (rating or pass status) in your application.



Documented LET review experience. Either lecturing at a recognised review centre (Carl Balita Review Center, Lyceum, Inteleq, Eduphil, or similar) OR running independent paid review classes with verifiable evidence (recordings, testimonials, enrolment records).



Strong written English.



Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) for cross-referencing. We are an AI-forward team and you will use these daily.



Reliable async communicator. We work via
, WhatsApp, and Loom. No required daily calls.



Reliable internet (minimum 25 Mbps).



STRONGLY PREFERRED



Master's degree in Education or a related field.



Graduate of Philippine Normal University (PNU), University of the Philippines, Ateneo de Manila, or De La Salle University.



Currently or recently lecturing at a recognised review centre.



Authored exam-style questions for board exams, review materials, or published textbooks.



Active social media presence in teacher education 
, TikTok, YouTube).



Top-10 LET placer or top-rank candidate.



DepEd K-12 curriculum and PPST (Philippine Professional Standards for Teachers) fluency.



ROLE LOGISTICS



Hours: 15 to 40 hours per week (part-time or full-time), flexible. You set your own working pattern.



Pay: USD 10 to 15 per hour (approximately PHP 600 to 900 per hour), depending on experience and credentials. We will confirm the exact rate on the call.



Payment cadence: weekly in arrears, every Friday, via Wise. Direct to your PH bank or Wisetag.



Term: 2-week paid trial first. Ongoing if it works.



Start date: as soon as possible. We want to be live by late June for the September LET cycle.



Remote: fully remote, no office, no commute.



APPLICATION



Send your application including ALL of the following. Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed.



1. Your LPT licence number and year of registration.



2. Year you personally took the LET and your result (rating or pass status).



3. Your specialist subject area (Elementary, English, Filipino, Mathematics, Science, Social Studies, etc.).



4. Documented LET review experience. If at a centre, name the centre and the years you lectured there. If independent, share evidence (lesson recordings, testimonials, course pages).



5. Bachelor's degree institution and graduation year. Master's degree if applicable.



6. Three (3) sample MCQs you have personally written, on any LET topic. Include the stem, options, marked correct answer, and a brief explanation. This shows us your question-writing instincts.



7. Active social media link in the teacher education space, if you have one.



8. One paragraph on why this role specifically interests you. Generic templates will be auto-rejected.



9. Your hourly rate expectation in PHP.



Promising candidates will be granted access to our private dev course (Course 150 LET Elementary Review) and asked to review 15 MCQs of their choice. £10 paid on completion regardless of outcome. Then a final 30-minute video call.



ABOUT MEEDU



We are a small UK ed-tech team building exam-prep platforms across multiple verticals (currently UK dentistry and medicine, expanding to LET and others). Our founder is a UK-trained dentist building Meedu alongside clinical work. We use AI heavily for content generation and rely on senior human experts to review and refine.



If you are a senior, highly qualified teacher passionate about raising the bar for Filipino teacher education, we want to talk to you.

The role is 100% remote, and we are looking for a long-term teammate.



After 3 months, we run a full-time conversion interview. 

If you prefer to stay part-time after that, that's also fine. You can keep working with us part-time for as long as you want.





How we work



- We are a fully remote, async team. You own your schedule and your work.

- We care about results, not hours sat at a desk.

- We use AI tools heavily in our daily work (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and so on). Not as a buzzword, but because they actually save time. We expect you to use them too.

- The frontend stack changes quickly. We want someone who keeps up, tries new things, and brings what they learn back to the team.

- We share what we know. If you know something, teach it. If you don't, ask. Everyone here grows because we listen to each other.

- We don't want someone who just waits for tasks. We want someone who understands why the work matters, owns it from start to finish, and figures things out on their own when needed.





What you will do



- Build web frontends for Korean and Japanese clients (landing pages, marketing sites, dashboards, SaaS, internal tools) using React and Next.js.

- Work with backend APIs provided by our backend team.

- Turn Figma designs into clean, responsive UI.

- Keep the code, performance, and component structure in good shape.

- Work closely with designers and backend developers, mostly in writing.

- Iterate fast based on client and internal feedback.





Requirements



- 1 to 3 years of frontend development experience.

- Solid working knowledge of React and Next.js.

- Comfortable working with REST / JSON APIs, including auth, error handling, and edge cases.

- Good HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript or TypeScript fundamentals.

- Experience with responsive design and cross-browser issues.

- Used to Git-based workflows (branches, PRs, code review).

- Enough English to handle text-based async communication.

- A link to your work (GitHub, personal site, deployed projects). Please send links only, not file attachments.





What we care about most



- Your drive to grow matters more than your current skill level.

- You don't need to be perfect right now. You can learn after joining.

- Mindset, logic, and growth potential matter more to us than what you can do today.

- We want people who think for themselves, not people who wait to be told what to do.





Nice to have



- TypeScript.

- Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, or similar modern styling stacks.

- State management (Zustand, Redux, React Query, etc.).

- Understand about Amazon AWS, EC2/ECS/S3

- A basic sense for UI/UX so you can talk things through with designers.

- Some sense of Korean, Japanese, or wider Asian product and design trends.

- Open source contributions or side projects.





Pay and benefits



- $4 to $10 per hour, based on experience and portfolio.

- Paid by actual hours worked.

- Any AI or productivity tool you need is covered. ChatGPT Pro, Claude Max, whatever helps you work better.

- After 3 months, we cover 100% of self-development costs (courses, books, conferences, learning subscriptions, and so on).

- Pay is formally reviewed every 6 months. If you bring objective reasons for a raise, we will do our best to meet you there.





How to apply



Step 1. Send your application.

Send a short intro, your background, and a link to your work (GitHub, personal site, deployed projects).

To show that you actually read the post, please put "Cloudless" at the top of your message.



Step 2. Paid coding task and short interview.

Shortlisted candidates get a short coding task (about 1 to 2 hours of work).

Even if you are not selected after the task, we will pay you $20 USD for your time.



Step 3. Final hire and onboarding on the first project.





* Because of the volume of applications, we may not be able to reply to everyone individually. Sorry in advance, and thank you for understanding.

title: Social Media Community Assistant — Hair & Beauty Brand (Instagram + TikTok)
description:
Salary: Competitive, based on experience. Reviewed regularly with opportunity for raises and bonuses based on performance.



Hours: Full-time, 8 hours/day, Monday–Friday, 6am–3pm Manila time (with a 1hr break) 

Type: Full-time, long-term (we are not looking for part-time or freelance)



About Us

Phantom Towels is a fast-growing hair and beauty brand based in the UK, with customers in the UK and US. We make premium salon towels and capes for hairdressers and beauty professionals, and we have a large, inclusive, engaged community on Instagram and TikTok. Our tagline is "The sidekick every hairdresser deserves." We're confident, bold, approachable, and a little bit playful — never corporate.



The Role

You'll be joining our small, friendly team and reporting directly to our Social Media Community Manager (who is also based in the Philippines and works 2pm–11pm Manila time, giving you a couple of hours of overlap each day).

Your main job is to grow our community by finding the right people on Instagram and TikTok and starting genuine conversations with them. The goal is to introduce them to Phantom Towels and move them along a journey — from a first DM, to signing up for our
 list, to receiving a free sample, to becoming a content collaborator, and eventually a paying customer.



Day to day, you'll be:

- Identifying high-quality leads (hairdressers, salon owners, beauty professionals, content creators) on Instagram and TikTok

- Starting and managing DM conversations in our brand voice

- Using ManyChat to tag leads and follow up with them systematically

- Sending out free product samples to qualified leads

- Working closely with our Social Media Community Manager to refine and improve our lead generation system

- Sending a short end-of-day
 summary of what you've worked on each day



What We're Looking For

The right person is trustworthy, well-organised, hard-working, and eager to learn. We care more about character and work ethic than a perfect CV. If you don't tick every box below but you're a great communicator and a fast learner, we'd still love to hear from you.



Must-haves:

- Excellent spoken and written English (we operate in UK and US markets — your DMs will be read by native English speakers every day)

- Excellent and reliable internet connection

- Confident, daily user of Instagram and TikTok — you understand how the platforms work, what good content looks like, and how people talk in DMs

- Available full-time, Mon–Fri, 6am–3pm Manila time

- Able to commit to this as your only full-time job



Nice-to-haves (but not essential — we'll train you):

- Experience with ManyChat

- Experience with Shopify

- Experience with Klaviyo

- Previous experience in social media, community management, or sales/outreach

- Interest in the hair and beauty industry or e-commerce generally



What You Can Expect From Us

- A long-term role with a growing brand — we want to build a relationship, not churn through people

- Clear training and support from your manager

- Regular feedback, and pay reviews based on performance

- Bonuses for great work

- A friendly, supportive team that treats you with respect

- Flexibility when you need personal time — just let us know in advance



How to Apply

Please send a short reply (a few sentences, in your own words — not a CV list) telling us:

- A bit about yourself and your experience with Instagram and TikTok

- Why this role interests you



Please put the word "Sidekick" at the top of your reply so we know you read this whole post carefully.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Customer Service Team Member
description:
Banana Home (Online Furniture - Australia) is looking for a dependable, customer-focused individual to join our team as an offshore Customer Service Representative. In this role, you'll work behind the scenes to keep our customer communications running smoothly, supporting our onshore team who handles the more complex casework. 



You'll be the first point of contact for many of our customers, ensuring inquiries are answered promptly, comments are responded to, and our customers feel looked after at every touchpoint.This is an ideal role for someone who is organised, has excellent written English, enjoys helping people, and takes pride in clear, friendly communication.



Key Responsibilities


 & Inbox Management



Respond to basic customer
 inquiries in a clear, friendly, and professional tone

Triage incoming
s — answering what you can directly, and escalating more complex matters to the onshore team with a clear summary

Keep the shared inbox tidy, ensuring nothing slips through the cracks and response times stay within service-level targets



Proactive Customer Communication



Reach out to customers via provided contact lists for follow-ups, check-ins, updates, and reminders

Send proactive communications using approved templates and provided customer details

Log all outbound communications accurately in our CRM or tracking system



General Customer Service



Reply to customer comments across our communication channels 
, social, reviews) in line with brand voice and guidelines

Provide accurate information on products, orders, delivery, and general inquiries

Maintain detailed and accurate customer records



Complaint Handling (Light)



Acknowledge and respond to straightforward customer complaints with empathy and professionalism

Resolve simple issues using established processes and templates

Escalate complex, sensitive, or high-value complaints to the onshore team with full context



Team Support



Work closely with the onshore team, providing them with clean handovers when escalating cases

Follow established SOPs and flag opportunities to improve processes or templates

Take on ad-hoc light admin tasks related to customer service as needed



What We're Looking For

Essential



Excellent written English, clear, friendly, and grammatically strong

1+ years of customer service experience, ideally in an
 or chat-based role

Comfortable working independently and managing your own workflow

Strong attention to detail and good organisational skills

Reliable internet connection and a quiet home workspace

Comfortable with
 platforms, CRM tools, and basic spreadsheets



Nice to Have



Experience in e-commerce, retail, or home-related industries

Familiarity with tools like Zendesk, Gorgias, Freshdesk, Intercom, or similar

Experience handling social media comments or reviews



Work Arrangement



Fully remote (offshore)

Working hours: [to be confirmed, overlap with onshore team hours preferred]

Reporting to: Customer Service Lead (onshore)



How to Apply

If you're a friendly, detail-oriented communicator who enjoys helping people and working as part of a small, supportive team, we'd love to hear from you. Please send your CV and a short cover note telling us a little about your customer service experience.



Must have your own PC already and have experience with customer service. Working hours will be a standard 9-to-5 day in the Philippines. Since we are in Australia, our working hours are similar to yours, so you’ll be able to work a few hours behind schedule.

title: Top-Tier Short-Form Video Ad Editor for Medspa Clients
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled short-form video ad editor who can create premium, aesthetic, high-converting video ads for medspa clients.



Our agency works with medspas and aesthetic clinics, and we need someone who understands how to make ads that feel clean, polished, trustworthy, and visually engaging — not cheap, generic, or overly salesy.



**This is not a beginner editing role.**



We are looking for a top-tier short-form ad editor who already has experience creating short-form advertisements. You should understand what makes people stop scrolling, how to structure a strong hook, how to use text overlays effectively, and how to combine visuals, pacing, voiceovers, and CTAs into a polished final ad.



We are not looking for someone who is still learning the basics of editing or someone who only makes simple social media clips. We want someone who understands both editing and advertising.



You should be comfortable creating short-form ads for platforms like
, Instagram, Reels, Stories, and TikTok using stock footage, aesthetic social media-style clips, voiceovers, text overlays, and strong pacing.



The type of ads we need:



* 30–60 second short-form video ads

* Premium, and satisfying aesthetic medspa-style edits

* Ads that feel clean, polished, and trustworthy

* Strong hooks in the first few seconds

* Clear text overlays and calls to action

* Smooth pacing and visually engaging clips

* Content that feels native to social platforms but still high-end



The style we like:

Think clean medspa visuals, glowing skin, smooth skin texture, skincare treatments, luxury beauty content, confident voiceovers, satisfying clips, and ads that make someone stop scrolling without feeling spammy.



The ads should feel like they belong to a reputable local medspa or high-end aesthetic clinic.



What we’re looking for:



* Experience editing short-form video ads

* A strong eye for premium, aesthetic visuals

* Ability to create ads that feel high-end and trustworthy

* Understanding of hooks, pacing, text overlays, voiceovers, and CTAs

* Experience using stock footage or TikTok/Instagram-style clips

* Ability to make ads feel native to
, Instagram, Reels, Stories, and TikTok

* Bonus if you have experience with medspa, beauty, skincare, wellness, or aesthetic brands



Please send:



* 2–3 of the best short-form advertisements you’ve created

* Your typical turnaround time for a 30–60 second ad



Important:

Please do not send portfolio links, website links, Google Drive folders, or generic reels. Portfolio links will not be reviewed or considered.



I only want to see 2–3 of your best short-form ad edits — not your entire portfolio.



We are looking for someone who can create ads that are visually premium, strategically edited, and built to convert.



Only apply if you are confident your work can stand out from the average editor.

title: Part-Time Web/App Designer for KR/JP Projects (Flexible Hours)
description:
Hello. This is Jayden Kim from Flash Studio.

Flash Studio is a development studio working on a variety of web and app outsourced projects for clients in Korea and Japan. We're looking for a Part-Time Web/App Designer to take charge of the design work for these projects.



Working hours are about 3~4 hours per day, with no fixed schedule.

As long as deadlines are met, you can work at night, early morning, or whenever works best for you.

The role is 100% remote, and we prefer long-term collaboration.



After 3 months from your start date, we will conduct a full-time conversion interview.

If you prefer to stay part-time, that's completely fine. You can continue working with us as a part-timer for as long as you'd like.



Responsibilities



- Website design for Korean and Japanese clients (landing pages, marketing sites, dashboards, SaaS, etc.)

- Mobile app UI design (iOS / Android)

- End-to-end design process from wireframes to high-fidelity mockups and prototypes

- Building and improving our design system and internal design workflow from the ground up

- Clean handoff to developers (specs, assets included)

- Fast iteration based on client and internal feedback



Requirements



- Portfolio with web and/or app design work that YOU personally designed

  * You must provide a live link (Behance, Dribbble, personal site, Notion, Figma, etc.) where we can review the work.

  * File attachments will NOT be reviewed. Link only.

- Proficiency in Figma and Adobe tools (Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.) for both high-quality UI design and Visual design

- Ability to propose logical solutions based on both quantitative and qualitative data

- Ability to build and scale a design system and operational workflow from the early stage

- Strong sense for modern web/app design with solid fundamentals (typography, layout, color)

- Experience with responsive design

- English communication sufficient for text-based asynchronous collaboration



What We Value Most



- Your willingness and drive to GROW is our #1 priority.

- Your design skills don't have to be perfect right now. You can learn and level up after joining.

- We care more about your mindset, logic, and growth potential than your current skill ceiling.



Nice to Have



- Experience building design systems

- Understanding of iOS HIG / Material Design

- Motion or micro-interaction experience

- Basic understanding of HTML/CSS

- Familiarity with Korean/Japanese or broader Asian design trends



Compensation & Benefits



- $4 ~ $8 USD per hour, based on experience and portfolio

- Paid as a flat amount for actual hours worked

- Unlimited support for any AI / productivity tools you need. Figma Make, ChatGPT, Claude and any other tool that helps you work better.

- After 3 months from your start date, we reimburse 100% of any self-development expenses (courses, books, conferences, learning subscriptions, etc.).

- Salary is formally renegotiated every 6 months. If you bring objective reasons for a raise, we will do our best to meet you there.



How to Apply



Step 1. Portfolio Submission

Please send your portfolio along with a short introduction and your background.

To show that you've read the post all the way through, please write "MOONLIGHT" at the top of your message.



Step 2. Paid Design Task

Shortlisted candidates will receive a short design task (about 1~2 hours of work).

Even if you are not selected after the task, we will pay you $20 USD for your time.



Step 3. Final Hire and Onboarding on the First Project



Please Note

- If you are not selected, we will not send a separate rejection notice. Thank you for your understanding.

title: Funnelish funnel builder
description:
Hey there,



We are looking for a new tea
mber to join our fast-growing 6-figure eCommerce business.



We run multiple online stores in the EU and are scaling fast. Because of this, we need to expand our team.



We are looking for someone responsible for one of the most important tasks in our business:

building complete, high-converting sales funnels.



You will turn products into full branded offers.



This includes:



- Product naming



- Logo creation



- Improving the copy



- Creating images that fit the copywriting



- Delivering a funnel that is ready to launch and convert



- This role requires speed, creativity, and attention to detail.



You will receive competitor funnels and ready-made templates as a base, which you will adapt, improve, and finalize into branded, high-converting funnels.



Meeting deadlines is extremely important.



We are looking for someone who is hardworking, smart, dedicated, detail-oriented, and able to work with minimal supervision.



Pay is excellent and this will become a full-time role with bonuses.



Please read the 4R model below for full details.



4R MODEL - FUNNEL BUILDER



ROLE



- You are responsible for building complete, branded sales funnels.



- You receive competitor funnels as inspiration and ready-made templates, then:



- Adapt them to our structure



- Improve and refine the copy where needed



- Create branding and visuals



- Deliver a polished, ready-to-launch funnel



Your work directly supports our testing and scaling process.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Analyze competitor funnels and use them as inspiration



- Adapt competitor structure and copy to fit our templates and brand style



- Improve copywriting where needed



- Create a unique brand name and logo for each product



- Create images that fit and support the copywriting



- Think of unique selling points and angles when needed



- Communicate proactively with the team and flag any blockers



- Meet agreed deadlines



- Track working hours using our time tracking tool



RESULTS



- Funnels that meet our quality standards and KPIs



- Funnels inspired by competitors but clearly improved and adapted



- Clean, professional branding that builds trust



- Clear, effective copy that supports conversions



- Consistent and reliable delivery



- Smooth collaboration with the team



REQUIREMENTS



- Experience with Funnelish or other page builder tools



- Basic graphic design skills such as logo creation and image editing



- Ability to analyze and adapt existing content



- Fluent in English



- Able to work independently with minimal supervision



- Organized, reliable, and deadline-driven



- Proactive communicator who asks questions when needed



- Plus: Previous experience in eCommerce or direct-response environments



WHAT WE OFFER



- Full-time position, Monday to Friday, weekends off



- Excellent hourly pay with performance-based raises



- Bonus system linked to KPIs



- Time tracking for accurate payment



- Long-term role with growth opportunities as we scale from 6 to 7-8 figures



- Clear SOPs, templates, and competitor examples



- Fast-paced environment with strong learning opportunities



Ready to grow with us?



If you are a fast learner, enjoy structured creative work, and want to be part of a growing eCommerce team, we want to hear from you.



Please send:



- Your resume



- Samples of your work



- A short cover letter explaining why you think you are a good fit

title: Client Success Coordinator (Remote)
description:
Client Success Coordinator (Remote)



About M44 Collective



Note: Will not entertain anything less than 7 AP (Apply Points)



M44 Collective is a fast-growing Singapore-based performance marketing agency focused on helping businesses grow through Meta Ads, Google Ads, landing pages, and conversion-focused marketing systems.



We work with businesses both services and e-com.



As a startup, we move fast, solve problems quickly, and continuously improve our systems, operations, and client experience.



We are looking for a proactive, highly organized, and strong communicator to join our team as a Client Success Coordinator.



This is a long-term remote role with strong growth opportunities for the right person.







Working Hours



Singapore Time Zone (GMT+8)



Monday to Friday

9:00 AM to 6:30 PM







About The Role



This role acts as the operational bridge between clients and our internal delivery team.



Once a client signs with M44, you will help manage the onboarding process, coordinate communication, organize approvals and revisions, and ensure projects move smoothly between the client and our internal team.



You will work closely with:



* Founder

* Media Buyers

* Marketing Strategists

* Graphic Designers

* Video Editors

* Clients



This is NOT a sales role.



You will not be required to close clients or lead sales calls.



Instead, your role is focused on:



* communication

- Shaggy Chic full brand kit (same scope as Chic Kitty above)

- Pinterest pin templates (3-5 variations) for both Chic Kitty AND Shaggy Chic

- Pinterest profile banners for both



Milestone 3 — Hugo + Cats of the World — $300

Week 3 (5-7 days). Deliverables:

- Hugo full brand kit (IG PFP, Highlight covers, carousel masters, Story templates, Reel cover, FB Page cover,
 signature) PLUS Hugo TikTok kit (TikTok PFP, profile banner, video thumbnail templates)

- Cats of the World kit (IG-only currently): PFP, Highlight covers, carousel masters in monochrome aesthetic, Story templates, Reel cover



Milestone 4 — Course + Polish — $250

Week 4 (5-7 days). Deliverables:

- Paws to Profit course brand assets: Kajabi landing page header, 5 module thumbnails (one per course module), 3 sales page section graphics, founding member welcome graphic, course completion certificate template

- Pre-launch teaser graphics (3 versions for August campaign)

- Launch day announcement graphics (3 versions for September 8-12 launch)

- Affiliate program promotional kit (1 carousel + 1 Story + 1 Pinterest pin)

- IG Highlight covers (5-6 per brand) across all four launched brands

- Notion header images per brand workspace

- Drive folder header graphics per brand workspace

- Loom thumbnail template (universal)



Timeline target: 3-4 weeks from kickoff. If you deliver quality early, we can compress. 4 weeks is the absolute hardline.



HOW EACH MILESTONE GETS APPROVED



After each milestone delivery:

- Operations Manager tests templates by swapping sample photos and text

- All templates must use locked brand palettes (color picker confirms exact hex)

- Fonts must be correctly assigned per brand

- Smart frames and toggles must work without breaking the layout

- Type-in-panels rule must be respected (no text floating on photos)

- First-slide animal-hero rule must be respected on all carousels

- If milestone passes: payment released, move to next milestone

- If milestone fails: one revision round granted. If still failing after revision, the project ends, and you keep payment for completed milestones



OUR DESIGN DNA — STRICT RULES YOU FOLLOW



- The animal is always the subject. Photo dominates 70-80% of every carousel slide. Type is a footnote.

- Type lives in PANELS, never overlays photos. Solid color panel with text inside, sitting next to or below the photo. No text floating on top of the image.

- Splash rule: italic + splash color, both effects together. Example: a single word italicized in Cranberry on Chic Kitty.

- First slide of every carousel = full-bleed animal hero photo. Tiny brand wordmark in the corner. Nothing else.

- Slides 2-4: photo + small text panel (?8 words text).

- Slide 5 (final): CTA card. Brand color background. Single sentence + link cue.



Our reference brands: The Row, Aesop, Kinfolk magazine, Jacquemus, and Bottega Veneta. Restraint signals confidence. Not pet brands.



BRAND CONTEXT — WHAT YOU'LL WORK WITH



Five brands, one family architecture. Every brand uses a 5-slot palette structure (workhorse, splash, essence, bone, and ink). Same architecture, different colors. Body font is DM Sans family-wide.



- Chic Kitty (parent) — Plum Noir + Cranberry — Cormorant Garamond — editorial cat lover's edit

- Shaggy Chic (parent) — Marine + Antique Brass — Spectral — east coast lifestyle warmth

- Hugo (ambassador) — Deep Olive + Burnt Amber — Bodoni Moda Bold ALL CAPS — chaos curated, deadpan

- Cats of the World — Ink (monochrome) + Twilight — DM Sans Light lowercase — documentary street cats

- Paws to Profit (course) — palette and typography spec provided at kickoff



We will provide full brand reference documents at kickoff.



WHAT YOU'RE NOT DOING



- NOT redesigning our brand identities (palettes, fonts, architecture are locked)

- NOT designing individual sub-brand logos beyond the Chickitty Brands parent wordmark

- NOT custom illustration

- NOT photography or photo editing

- NOT ongoing daily content design (OBM swaps photos/text into your masters after delivery)



REQUIREMENTS



- Canva Pro proficient — must understand smart frames, magic switch, hide/show toggles

- Editorial design portfolio — we'll review your work for tonal fit

- Strong typography eye — must respect the type-in-panels rule

- Comfortable executing locked brand systems, not making identity decisions

- Strong written English for async collaboration

- Available 25-40 hours over the next 3-4 weeks



WHAT WE'RE NOT LOOKING FOR



- Heavy graphics, busy templates, anything that competes with the photo

- Trendy patterns, stickers, hand-drawn elements

- Bright over-saturated palettes

- Anyone who wants to redesign our brand systems (please don't — they're locked)

- AI-generated design work. We are a 100% AI-free brand and require all designs to be human-created. Confirm in your application.



PAYMENT



- Total $1,100 USD across 4 milestones ($250 + $300 + $300 + $250)

- Plus $50 USD paid test before hire

- Paid via Wise, Remitly, or PayPal (your choice)

- Work-for-hire, all IP transfers to us



APPLICATION — REQUIRED



Please include:

1. Link to your portfolio (Canva templates preferred; Figma/InDesign also acceptable)

2. ONE specific example of editorial/minimalist template work you've done — link or attachment

3. Confirmation you can commit to the 3-4 week timeline starting between May 25 and June 15

4. Brief note on your favorite reference brand from this list (The Row, Aesop, Kinfolk, Jacquemus, Bottega Veneta) and why

5. Confirmation you work 100% AI-free OR commit to working AI-free on this project

6. Acknowledge you understand this is milestone-based pay, not lump-sum upfront



We respond to qualified applicants within 5 days. The top 1-2 finalists receive the $50 paid test before the final hiring decision.

title: Long-Term Short-Form Video Editor — Fitness Creator (500K+ following) — Start ASAP, 8-Week Europe Project + Ongoing
description:
Hi! I’m a fitness content creator with 521,000 followers across Instagram and TikTok. I’m hiring a dedicated short-form video editor for a long-term role starting in the next 2 weeks.

THIS IS A LONG-TERM POSITION — not a one-off project. I’m looking for someone to work with me for at least 12 months, ideally years.



ABOUT THE WORK:

You will edit 8–12 short-form Reels and TikToks per week from raw iPhone footage I film at the gym. The style I need is fast-cut, native-feeling, trending-audio-driven — the kind of edit that looks like I made it myself on CapCut. Cinematic editing is NOT what I need (I have another editor for that). I need snappy, energetic, scroll-stopping cuts.



WHY THE TIMING MATTERS:

I’m travelling to Europe in approximately 4 weeks for an 8-week content trip. I will be filming across multiple European cities. I need you fully trained and producing at full capacity BEFORE I leave, so the content keeps flowing while I’m travelling. While I’m in Europe, our workflow will be: I film and upload during the European day, you edit overnight Philippine time, I wake up to finished edits in the morning Europe time, I approve and post.

THIS IS A REAL OPPORTUNITY. The Europe trip is a major growth push for my account. Whoever I hire will be a core part of that growth.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EACH WEEK:

• Receive a Google Drive folder of raw iPhone footage each day

• Edit 1–2 short-form videos per day (vertical 9:16, 15–45 seconds each)

• Sync trending audio (you stay on top of what’s hitting on TikTok)

• Add burned-in captions in a clean style

• Suggest a caption (1 sentence) for each Reel

• Deliver finished cuts within 24 hours of receiving footage

• Communicate via WhatsApp daily

WHAT I NEED FROM YOU:

• Strong portfolio of short-form work — even if it’s not fitness, I want to see your sense of pacing

• Experience with CapCut Pro (preferred) or Premiere Pro

• Fast turnaround — under 24 hours from footage to edit

• Available to work overnight Philippine time during my Europe trip (this aligns with European daytime)

• Reliable internet for uploading/downloading large video files

• Long-term commitment — minimum 12 months



WHAT I OFFER:

• $300–400 USD per month for part-time work (~15–20 hours/week)

• Weekly payment via Wise on Fridays

• 90-day probation period — if it works, your rate increases to $400–500/month

• 13th-month bonus around Christmas (yes, even though you’re a contractor)

• Long-term stability — I want to build a relationship, not churn through editors

• Clear feedback, written briefs, no chaos



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR:

You don’t need to be a fitness expert. You don’t need to have edited for big creators before. What I need is:

• Eye for pacing — you instinctively know when a cut should land

• Energy and curiosity for what’s trending on TikTok right now

• Reliability — when you say 24 hours, you mean 24 hours

• Hunger to grow with a creator who’s growing fast



HOW TO APPLY:

Send me a message that includes these 4 things, in this order:

 1. Your name and where in the Philippines you live

 2. 2–3 links to your best short-form edits (Google Drive, YouTube, or portfolio site — NOT just a CV)

 3. Answer this in 2 sentences: “What’s one TikTok trend you’ve seen in the last 7 days that I should be using for fitness content?”

 4. Confirm: are you available to work during European daytime hours (3pm–11pm Philippine time) for 8 weeks starting in approximately 5 weeks?

I will only read applications that include all 4 things. Generic CVs and template cover letters will not be reviewed. The 4 items above are the only application I need.

Looking forward to finding the right person for a long-term role.

title: CLOSER — Legal Document Services (High Ticket | Performance Bonus + Base
description:
CLOSER — Legal Document Services (High Ticket | Performance Bonus + Base | 



About the Company



We are a fast-growing legal document services company operating across the United States. We help people in urgent legal situations get the documents they need — fast. Our clients are real people facing real deadlines. When they call us, they need help today, not next week.



We are expanding rapidly and need a closer who can handle high-pressure, high-compassion sales conversations with people who are motivated, urgent, and ready to move — if you present the solution correctly.

This is not cold calling. Every person you speak with has already been contacted and called us back. They have a problem. You have the solution. Your job is to match them to the right service, present the price confidently, and close.



What You Will Do



Take inbound callbacks from pre-qualified leads

Conduct a structured intake call to determine which service track the client needs

Ask the qualifying questions, collect all case information, and enter it into our CRM in real time during the call

Present the service and price clearly and confidently

Use our two-step closing process for high-ticket cases

Collect payment via our online checkout system before ending the call

Hand off to our document team immediately after payment



You will not prospect. You will not cold call. You will not chase leads. Every call comes to you.



Who We Are Looking For

This role is for you if:



You are fluent in English AND/ or  Spanish is a plus but not necessary—both written and spoken, native level. 



You have experience in high-ticket phone sales, closing, or collections

You are calm under pressure. Our clients are stressed. You are not.

You are comfortable discussing urgent, sensitive situations with empathy and confidence

You follow a script and a process — you do not freelance on calls

You are honest. You never overpromise. You never guarantee outcomes.

You are available 7 days a week on a rotating schedule

You are based in the Philippines and have a reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace



This role is NOT for you if:



You freeze when a client pushes back on price

You feel uncomfortable asking for payment on the first call

You need to think about whether to follow the process — it is not optional

You cannot handle emotional conversations calmly and professionally



The Qualifying Questions You Will Ask on Every Call

You will be trained on these. They are not optional. Every call follows this framework:



What is your monthly rent?

Were you properly served with the original court papers?

Did you have a valid reason for not appearing in court?

Has your landlord ignored repair requests or had code violations on the property?

Did this situation begin after you complained about something or requested repairs?



Your answers to these questions determine which service track the client needs and what price you quote. The pricing formula is simple — you will have it in front of you on every call.



Compensation

Our closers average $2,400–$3,000 per month. Top performers earn $3,500 and above.



Base salary: $600 USD per month — guaranteed

Performance bonus on every closed deal — paid weekly

Rush upsell bonus: included

No cap on earnings



This is not a stretch goal. This is what happens when a motivated closer follows the process on inbound callbacks from people who are ready to buy. Our leads call us back. Your job is to close them.

Performance bonus is paid on collected revenue only. No payment collected, no bonus earned.



Schedule

7 days a week operation. You will work 5 days on, 2 days off on a rotating schedule. Shifts cover US business hours across multiple time zones. Exact shift discussed during interview.



Non-Negotiables



Bilingual EN/ES — native fluency in both

Quiet professional workspace

Reliable high-speed internet

Ability to roleplay the qualification script live during the interview — this is part of the hiring process

Willingness to be monitored and coached on calls during the first 30 days





How to Apply

Send your application to 
] with the subject line: CLOSER APPLICATION — EN/ES

Include:



A short voice recording (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself in English, then switching to Spanish and explaining why you are the right person for this role

Your resume or work history

Your available start date



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.

description:
We’re seeking a highly organised, research focused virtual assistant to source acquisition opportunities, contact brokers and maintain an accurate deal pipeline. You will be the first point of contact between me and brokers, so confidence, clarity and discretion are essential.



Key Responsibilities

 - Research: Actively hunt broker sites, marketplaces and directories to find deals that fit our “buy box,” not just random listings.

 - Outreach: Proactively contact brokers to request IMs, follow?up persistently and close the loop.

 - Pipeline: Maintain a live, accurate pipeline in CRM or spreadsheets, with clear status labels and follow?up dates.

 - Screening: Filter out clearly non?viable leads and escalate only those that genuinely warrant the principal’s time.

 - Urgency: Flag urgent or high?potential deals with a short, structured summary.



Growth Path (Post?Trial)

Once you prove you can consistently source, track, and qualify leads, you’ll move into deal analysis, including:

 - Structuring and summarising IMs in a consistent, investor?ready format.

 - Extracting KPIs (e.g., revenue, EBITDA, customer concentration, lease terms) and presenting them clearly.

 - Spotting and highlighting potential risks.

 - Comparing deals against our investment thesis.



Must-Have Qualifications

You are not a passive admin; you are the first point of contact between me and brokers. You must be comfortable initiating contact, following up assertively and protecting my reputation in every interaction.

 - Confident outbound communicator – Comfortable calling senior brokers and following up persistently if
 not working.

 - Proactive problem?solver – Owns follow-ups and escalates issues without being told.

 - Strong written English and business tone – Writes concise, professional outreach that sounds like a serious investor’s representative.

 - High?impact researcher – Goes beyond the first page results and finds genuinely relevant deals.

 - Extreme attention to detail – Keeps the pipeline clean and accurate.

 - Ownership mindset – Manages the pipeline as if it were their own.

 - Discretion and maturity – Handles confidential deal information professionally.



Preferred Experience

 - Experience in M&A, business brokerage, market research or lead generation.

 - Hands?on experience with CRM or structured spreadsheets.
